columns.comment: Core-banking account id; join to gold.dim_account.
columns.name: account_id

columns.comment: Core-banking customer number (source identity record) holding the account.
columns.name: cust_no

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: dim_client surrogate key of the account holder's current version.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Account type: Current Account, Savings Account, Time Deposit or Money Market Deposit.
columns.name: account_type

columns.comment: CASA (current and savings accounts) or TD (time and money-market deposits).
columns.name: deposit_class

columns.comment: APAC booking location of the account = the holder's coverage office (ISO-2).
columns.name: booking_country

columns.comment: Account status in core banking: ACTIVE, DORMANT or CLOSED.
columns.name: account_status

columns.comment: True when the account status is ACTIVE.
columns.name: is_active

columns.comment: Whole months from opening to the as-of date 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: account_age_months

comment: Core-banking deposit accounts (current, savings, time deposit, money market) with their golden client, product, CASA / TD class, currency, booking country and open date. Deposit balance, time-deposit, payment and liquidity-structure facts reference account_id. Grain: one row per core-banking account.
